freeze_timing_evidence.interpretation: Pinned driver/fit CLI ordering plus recorded command starts and current report mtimes agree with settings frozen before confirmation. Filesystem times are not independent tamper-proof timestamps.

limits: Best/last checkpoint bytes were hashed, not deserialized; native best-checkpoint restoration is supported by pinned source/history, not independently inspected model weights.
Post-transform training/validation matrix digests match frozen cached baseline records and each other across seeds; transformed counts were not regenerated or decoded.
Observed-to-export ID order was checked against frozen cached baseline public exports, with training IDs also matching the train-only gene manifest; H5AD count/observation arrays were not decoded.

State labels, biological transport costs, ridge probes and neighborhood/hubness diagnostics were not independently rerun. Native training reaches 200 epochs in both seeds, with patience reached exactly at the cap in seed1; these endpoints do not establish convergence or biological/causal correctness.
Two seeds reuse identical biological cells and are not independent biological-world replicates.
scope: Only two completed unrestricted realistic scMRDR baseline confirmation fits, fixed cached baseline references, and completed realistic GLUE report metadata. JSON/public train-val-discovery NPZ reads (including model-specific latent arrays), public H5AD/checkpoint byte hashes, source/version reads. No counts decoded, truth NPZ/private/protected biological cohort arrays, active informative GLUE output reads, checkpoint/model deserialization, CUDA, fits, causal evaluation or state/probe scoring reruns. Public ID sampling, arithmetic on recorded native losses/report costs, and descriptive variance/covariance statistics of the completed public shared embeddings only.

seed_difference_review.evidence: Same frozen full configuration except declared seed, installed/vendor/source/runtime, gene map, transformed training/validation digests and exact export/public-pool IDs. All recorded native losses and exported latent arrays are finite. Best-checkpoint metadata and stopping follow the original rule.
seed_difference_review.interpretation: The learned representation differs strongly with the declared integration seed: seed1 is nearly one-dimensional in public shared covariance, while seed0 retains about two effective directions. This is evidence of seed sensitivity and representation concentration, not an identified software/data/config mismatch or a proven causal mechanism for every matching error.
seed_difference_review.normalization_interpretation: G is an uncapped excess-cost ratio. Seed1 RNA matched costs exceed random expectation; G>1 is mathematically valid, not missing/undefined or clipped.
